continuity: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord survives the Bow Saint and Jeok Cheongang’s attacks, but is gravely injured; Sima Gong stabs his ankle, and Jeok’s Flame Divine Palm sends him crashing to a hillside beside the Grand Mage.

The Grand Mage’s barrier deflects Jin Taekyung’s final spear attack. Taekyung collapses, then breathes more steadily in the Grand Mage’s fading healing light; the reason she heals him rather than the Blood-Sword Demon Lord is unresolved.
The battle at the Great Snow Mountain continues, with Jeok Cheongang and the Bow Saint rushing toward the Blood-Sword Demon Lord.
plot: The Bow Saint and Jeok Cheongang badly wound the Blood-Sword Demon Lord, but Sima Gong stabs his ankle before he can counterattack. Jeok’s Flame Divine Palm sends him crashing onto a hillside near the Grand Mage. As the Grand Mage begins healing him, Jin Taekyung makes a last-ditch spear attack that her barrier deflects; he collapses, and the Grand Mage’s fading healing light has stabilized him instead. The Blood-Sword Demon Lord remains gravely injured, and the battle continues.
translation_decisions: Use Flame Divine Palm for 화염신장 and retain Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist for 멸염신권.

active_continuity: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord serves the Lord of Heaven and commands the invading army.
The Blood-Sword Demon Lord is gravely injured after Jeok Cheongang and the Bow Saint attack him; Sima Gong stabs his ankle, and he reaches the Grand Mage, who heals Jin Taekyung instead.
Jin Taekyung collapses after the Grand Mage’s barrier deflects his spear attack; her healing light stabilizes his breathing.
The battle at the Great Snow Mountain continues; Jeok Cheongang and the Bow Saint are closing in on the Blood-Sword Demon Lord.
The Grand Mage has not reappeared since the enormous fireball attack until this battle.
Sima Gong broke his bargain with Dark Heaven, aided Jeok Cheongang, and is gravely wounded and missing an arm; his fate remains unresolved.
Sima Gong hopes the Black Dragon Demon Gate will survive and grow stronger under his absent heir.
open_questions: What are the identity and purpose of the Lord of Heaven?
Did Dark Heaven cause the Great Faction War?
Who are the white-robed mages, and what is their purpose?
How were the former Demonic Cult fiends made into Black Ghosts?
Why did the Grand Mage’s healing light stabilize Jin Taekyung rather than heal the Blood-Sword Demon Lord?
temporary_decisions: Use Fire Ball, Stone Wall, and Magic Arrow for the named spells.
Render 헬 파이어 as Hell Fire; use hellfire for descriptive 겁화.
Render 쇄월검진 as Moon-Shattering Sword Formation.
